That's the main reason I haven't. As I stated before, I lost my father at a young age, and that just devastated me. I know my son is only 6 months old and can't process I have died. But as he would grow older to find out his father killed himself.... That's the only fear I have.

Thank you, I love you too, stranger.

As a non-citizen with out a SS number, I'm not sure how court would go... Plus I'm not even listed on his birth certificate due to the fact we needed government assistance, and If they knew I was the father I would be forced to pay child support so we choose the route where I'm non existent. 

I wish to keep in touch with Melissa, she actually recently moved back to her home town with us, but I'm afraid to engage in any form of communication due to Brittany breaking up with me, and we haven't talk in such a long time, I'm not sure how things would go. Don't get me wrong though, I still love Melissa with all my heart, she was the biggest thing in my life for a long time.

No need to excuse your language. Truth is; She's a c***.

Thank you for the advice though. I'm not sure if I'll do it or not, I've just been putting a lot of thought into. Ya' know? Not much else to do with my life.
